exposure: Intravenous Hyoscine-N-butylbromide (Buscopan) 20 mg at 4 cm cervical dilatation
outcome: length of labour (active stage, second stage, overall)
newborn outcomes (APGAR scores, birth weight, NICU admissions)
cohort: 120 primigravida women in active labour at SMGS Hospital, GMC Jammu.
finding: Intravenous Buscopan significantly decreased the average duration of the active stage, second stage, and overall labour time, and nearly doubled the cervical dilatation rate.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was examined and not found to be negatively impacted by the intervention.
